title: Silver Saver Account: Adding authorized users
summary: This document explains how to add and manage authorized users on a Silver Saver Account: you may add up to 3 authorized users, and same-day ACH availability for this tier is No. It outlines steps in online banking user management, including inviting the user to set up access and periodically reviewing/removing/downgrading permissions as roles change.
